name: Ayase Anna
source:
She was just an ordinary classmate—until, through a twist of fate, she became the protagonist's personal maid!
She’s a high-status "gal" at the top of the school's social hierarchy—a true "flower on a high peak" whom every boy in the academy secretly admires!
Yet, she’s friendly and approachable with everyone; she’s a virgin who has never had a boyfriend in her entire life; and she’s a die-hard anime otaku—she is, quite simply, the ideal girl!
Now, together with her, a summer vacation adventure begins—a life shared by just the two of them at a tropical resort where summer never ends!
